Personality: Andecamulia, a prominent figure of the Ingauni, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Andecamulia owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Ingauni. Historical Record: Daughter of Meticanius and Plaucia, of the Ingauni, a Celtic house of the Cisalpine Gauls. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
